Prices are listed in Euros. The text appears dense and somewhat blurry due to the camera focus or resolution.

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the menu text, particularly in the smaller descriptions and bottom-right section.
artifact_observations.reasoning: While the headers are legible ('ANTIPASTI', 'PRIMI PIATTI'), much of the smaller body text devolves into nonsensical character strings or blurred glyphs that mimic text structure without forming real words. This is a common AI artifact where the model captures the 'texture' of text but fails the semantic rendering.

artifact_observations.location: Lower half of the image and edges of the text blocks.
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a noticeable softness and lack of sharp edge definition in the text characters, contributing to the illegibility of the finer print. It resembles motion blur or out-of-focus photography rather than crisp printing.
The vertical alignment of the columns wavers slightly, and the rightmost column seems to warp inward unnaturally, suggesting a minor geometric inconsistency in how the flat surface was rendered.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In AI-generated menus, headers are often correct while body text fails. Determine if the level of gibberish renders the menu non-functional. Also, verify if the 'blur' is a photographic artifact (acceptable) or a generation failure (unacceptable).
